source: ARSO DMR 1 m bare earth (block 13, D96/TM), tiles TM1_484_44 .. TM1_488_47 mosaicked to E484000-489000 N44000-48000; epsilon priority-flood + D8 accumulation, the method of the homestead repo's 10-site/terrain-data/water.py
derived: branches of that D8 network with a catchment of 20000 m2 or more and at least 250 m long, chained (the biggest inflow carries on at a confluence, a tributary ends where it joins), simplified (RDP 1.2 m), smoothed (Chaikin x2) and stripped of the collinear points the smoothing leaves (RDP 0.15 m). Points are EPSG:3794 metres, in flow order.
note: A terrain model over the whole village, not a survey. The village lies in a closed karst basin (outlet 525.8 m, floor 451.5 m), so the fill is capped at 2 m and a course ends where it reaches a real sink instead of draining off the map - filling the basin outright drowns every channel in one flat. `stream_m2` is the catchment above which a course is drawn wide and named; below it a course is drawn thin and left unnamed, because 1 m bare earth cannot tell a brook from a dry gully.
